Aim: To find the common property of the objects.
Look at each object.
For the glass bottle, the smooth property is in common. The silk tie is not smooth.
The baseball bat is not blue.
The silk tie is made of silk, so it is flexible. But the glass bottle is not flexible. The answer is A.

A mineral is a solid that is naturally formed. A mineral forms in a single crystal or is made of one or more crystal structures. A crystal is a part of a mineral with a set pattern.
A mineral is not made by living things.
A mineral is a part of nature. It does not need to be made by people.
A mineral is a pure substance.
A mineral is made of one type of matter. This pure substance is called a mineral crystal.
A mineral is cut and sold separately. Minerals may be sold as small pieces or in crystal forms. But a mineral by itself is never sold. The answer is A.

A mineral is a nature deposit that has the following  properties:
It is a solid.
It is formed in nature.
It is not made by organisms.
It is a pure chemical substance.
It has a fixed crystal structure.
Igne minerals, such as granite, are formed when hot metal-rich lava cools and hardens into solid rock. Some rocks are formed when other rocks are changed into different rocks. This type of rock change is called metamorphism. Other rocks are formed when sediment is pressed together to form layers of sediment. Over time, the layers of sediment are pressed together to form rock. Plastic does not have all the properties of a mineral. So, plastic is not a mineral. The answer is A.
